status.en: 85 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 33% fewer than the week before, most of them in Gaza, Jerusalem and Hebron.
status.nb: 85 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 33 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Gaza, Jerusalem og Hebron.

summary.en: Heavy rains are flooding displacement camps across Gaza, damaging tens of thousands of tents and threatening the structural integrity of bomb-damaged buildings, while gunfire has struck tents at the Rafah site as aid teams prepare for winter storms. Israeli forces continue coalition negotiations, with talks gaining momentum and a candidate named to form the next government, while Israeli settlers seized eight Palestinian homes in Jericho, displacing dozens. The United Nations reported 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Kraftig regn oversvømmer forflytningsleirer i Gaza, ødelegger titusenvis av telt og truer den strukturelle integriteten til bombeskadede bygninger, mens skyting har rammet telt på Rafah-stedet mens hjelpearbeidere forbereder seg på vinterstormer. Israelske styrker fortsetter koalisjonsforhandlinger, med samtaler som får momentum og en kandidat som er navngitt for å danne neste regjering, mens israelske bosettere tok åtte palestinske hjem i Jeriko, og forflyttet dusinvis. FN rapporterte 21 440 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Gaza war
background.extract: The Gaza war is an armed conflict in the Gaza Strip and Israel, fought as part of the unresolved Israeli–Palestinian and Gaza–Israel conflicts. The war began on 7 October 2023, when Palestinian militant group Hamas led an attack on Israel, in which 1,195 Israelis and foreign nationals were killed and 251 were taken hostage. Since the start of the Israeli offensive that followed, over 74,000 Palestinians in Gaza have been killed; several studies in The Lancet indicate this figure is likely a significant undercount. Many scholarly sources and international organizations—including UN bodies, NGOs, and the International Association of Genocide Scholars—have concluded that Israel's actions in Gaza constitute genocide under international law. Several countries have also stated that genocide is occurring and have supported legal proceedings before the International Court of Justice. Israel and its supporters have denied that genocide has occurred.
background.extractNb: Krigen i Gaza er en krig mellom Israel og væpnede palestinske grupper, hovedsakelig Hamas, som har pågått på Gazastripen og i det sørlige Israel siden 7. oktober 2023. Konflikten er en del av den uløste Israel–Palestina-konflikten, og følger etter krigene i 2008–2009, 2014 og 2021.
